race.comment: WOODROW (6) faded late at his second run back with a respectable fourth over 1400m at Newcastle in C1 grade. Has the gate speed to get over from the wide draw and will be in this for a long way. GEMTIKI (8) doesn't boast the best winning strike rate but ran a nice race last time out, finishing fourth over 1600m at Newcastle. Winning rider hops back on and stays in the calculations. THE COMANCHE (5) finished second at this track two back before missing out at Tuncurry last time out over 1600m. Can atone. CANNYSTEP (1) returned to racing in good form but has gone off the boil in last two starts. Place contender if he can run up to that earlier form.
